_comment: Every image this repository publishes. Fields:
kind              build: compile from source. mirror: copy an image upstream publishes.
ref               branch name, or "semver-tag" for the highest vX.Y.Z tag (build only).
dockerfile        path in the upstream repository; the repository is the build context.
local_dockerfile  path in this repository; the build context is empty and the Dockerfile clones
the source using the UPSTREAM_REF and UPSTREAM_SHA build args.
inputs            upstream paths that affect the image. Changes elsewhere do not cause a rebuild.
cargo_closure     crate name. Adds that crate and its workspace path dependencies to inputs, and
hashes the Cargo.lock entries they reach.
recipe            increment to force a rebuild.
gated             true: send consumers a repository_dispatch for each new image. false: send nothing.

tranquil._why: Upstream publishes no image built with the native-tls-roots feature. See dockerfiles/tranquil-pds.Dockerfile.

pds-spaces-alpha._why: Bluesky publishes this image for amd64 only. Mirroring it gives consumers the same repository_dispatch as built targets.
